pattern:
Only 1 of the 13 wrong=true runs in this share (positions 4,9,...,64 of 66) is a real scored miss: CLOSURE-12-OWN-001 run-005. There the agent read the gold redefineIfLocal in full and wrote the exact mechanism in its evidence chain (null def site, early return, RHS reads lost), but ranked the caller computeMayUse first and the gold second. That is an attribution failure (caller holding the null encoding vs callee interpreting it), not a search failure. The other 12 are non-model failures and should be excluded from accuracy, not counted as misses:
- 10 are provider stalls: CLOSURE-23-MPO-001 x4, GSON-1-DISC-001 x1, LANG-1-MPO-001 x3, LANG-34-MPO-001 x2. Each trajectory stops on a tool message after 2-10 API calls, 15-88 s after launch, and the run sits idle until the 300 s timeout. CLOSURE-23-MPO run-007 has no trajectory at all.
- 1 is a harness defect: MOCKITO-28-CC-001 has an empty method catalog, so all 9 submissions were rejected with class_not_found, 8 of them with the gold comparator at rank 1.
- 1 is a pilot-era run with no trajectory: Chart-1 run-001, non-zero exit at roughly the 900 s budget.
In 5 of the 9 stalled runs that have a trajectory (CLOSURE-23-MPO run-001, LANG-1-MPO 003/009/014, LANG-34-MPO 007), the full gold body was already on screen before the stall. Across this share, the MPO arm has no scored evidence; its 'wrong' records are infrastructure artifacts.
